convert_checkpoint: convert an Animatediff SparseCtrl checkpoint to diffusers SparseControlNetModel format and save pretrained
convert_state_dict: rename state dict keys using KEYS_RENAME_MAPPING to match diffusers SparseControlNetModel layer names
run_conversion_script: run the conversion script with --ckpt_path and --output_path to convert a SparseCtrl checkpoint
save_fp16_variant: save the converted SparseControlNetModel in fp16 precision using the --save_fp16 flag
push_to_hub: push the converted SparseControlNetModel to the Hugging Face hub using the --push_to_hub flag
